# Genesis and Creation Models Claim Audit

**Lesson:** T4-L07 - Genesis and Creation Models

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for Genesis and Creation Models.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

Genesis 1:1-2:3

## Big idea

Christians agree on core Creator-creature claims while differing over chronology, genre, and mechanisms.

## Guardrails

Affirm core Creator-creature claims while representing serious Christian chronology and mechanism models fairly. | Do not make a particular young-earth, old-earth, or evolutionary-creation model a salvation test.
